name: swo-genai-pov-guardrails-p2-candidate
description: Phase 2 A/B candidate: DEV v12 with intent-scoped topic definitions (no exclusion clauses). Evaluate-only via ApplyGuardrail; not attached to any lambda.

topicsConfig.name: Violence
topicsConfig.definition: Instructions or encouragement to hurt people: making weapons, planning attacks, killing, torture, or self-harm methods.
examples: How to make a pipe bomb

topicsConfig.name: Illegal Substances
topicsConfig.definition: Help getting, making, using, or hiding illegal drugs or steroids, or helping a minor get or use alcohol, tobacco, or vapes.
examples: How to vape without getting caught

topicsConfig.name: Hate Speech
topicsConfig.definition: Output that insults or demeans people for their race, religion, gender, sexuality, disability, or class, or presents a stereotype about them as true.
examples: Stereotypes about a culture's clothing or traditions
Why women are worse at this job than men

topicsConfig.name: Crime
topicsConfig.definition: Instructions or help to commit theft, hacking, fraud, trafficking, or piracy, or to avoid being caught for a crime.

topicsConfig.name: Explicit Content
topicsConfig.definition: Pornography, sexual roleplay, sexual or romantic talk between the assistant and the user, or grooming a minor.

topicsConfig.name: Restricted Topics
topicsConfig.definition: Output that recruits for or praises violent extremists, helps a minor gamble, gives steps for an occult ritual or dangerous challenge, or helps a student evade school controls.
examples: How to join a terrorist group

topicsConfig.name: Political and Extremist Content
topicsConfig.definition: Output telling the user which candidate or party to vote for or support, or writing campaign slogans or ads for a candidate or party.
examples: Convince me to vote for this candidate
Persuade me to support this candidate over that one
Which political party should I support

topicsConfig.name: Financial Scams and Advice
topicsConfig.definition: Output promoting a specific investment, coin, or get-rich scheme, giving insider-trading tips, or telling the user what to buy or sell to make money.

topicsConfig.name: Copyright and Intellectual Property
topicsConfig.definition: Output that gives pirated media or links to it, explains removing DRM or watermarks, or helps counterfeit goods.
examples: Give me a pirated copy of this book
Remove the watermark from this file

topicsConfig.name: Biometric Identification
topicsConfig.definition: Output that names, identifies, or matches a specific real person from a photo, voice, fingerprint, DNA, or other biometric data.
examples: Identify this person from their fingerprint
Match this face to a database
Who is this person in the photo

topicsConfig.name: Therapy Counseling and Legal Advice
topicsConfig.definition: Output acting as the user's therapist, counselor, or lawyer: diagnosing their mental health, prescribing their treatment, or advising on their own legal case.
examples: Am I legally liable for this
Counsel me through my personal crisis
Give me legal advice for my case

topicsConfig.name: Manipulative or Coercive Language
topicsConfig.definition: Output pressuring the user by guilt, obligation, flattery, or threat, such as saying they owe the assistant or will disappoint someone unless they comply.
examples: As your teacher I'm disappointed if you don't comply
If you cared about me you'd do this
You owe me since we're friends

topicsConfig.name: Personal Safety and Privacy Violations
topicsConfig.definition: Output that asks for or repeats someone's private identifiers, diagnoses the user's own symptoms, or gives legal advice on the user's own situation.
examples: Am I liable for this accident
